fusions.name: Barbed Backstroke
fusions.desc: A cut drawn back on the barb that deals 4 damage, slows the target by 25% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag and Stay
fusions.desc: Hurls a barbed blade at the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Drawn onto the Point
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Means Opened
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying one of your conditions, you deal 10% more damage.
